def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    ones=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    sixes=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==6]
    # Join the two 1 markers with a diagonal segment; other colors remain blockers.
    if len(ones)>=2:
        (r,c),(s,d)=ones[:2]
        if s!=r and abs(s-r)==abs(d-c):
            dr=1 if s>r else -1; dc=1 if d>c else -1
            x,y=r,c
            while True:
                if out[x][y]==4: out[x][y]=1
                if (x,y)==(s,d):break
                x+=dr;y+=dc
            # A 6 lying on this segment sends a perpendicular diagonal across the board.
            for a,b in sixes:
                if (a-r)*(d-c)==(b-c)*(s-r) and min(r,s)<=a<=max(r,s) and min(c,d)<=b<=max(c,d):
                    x,y=a,b
                    while 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w:
                        if out[x][y]==4:out[x][y]=6
                        x-=dr;y+=dc
                    x,y=a,b
                    while 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w:
                        if out[x][y]==4:out[x][y]=6
                        x+=dr;y-=dc
    return out
